form.title: Annual Return To Report Transactions With Foreign Trusts and Receipt of Certain Foreign Gifts
form.question: Did you receive a distribution from, or were you the grantor of, or a transferor to, a foreign trust during the tax year?
form.notes: PRODUCES NO 1040 LINE. Triggered by a 'Yes' on Schedule B line 8. The Instructions for Schedule B say: 'Don’t attach Form 3520 to Form 1040 or Form 1040-SR. Instead, file it at the address shown in its instructions', and 'If you were treated as the owner of a foreign trust under the grantor trust rules, you are also responsible for ensuring that the foreign trust files Form 3520-A. Form 3520-A is due on March 16, 2026, for a calendar year trust.' No revision was read - this part did not fetch the form.
